compiled_state.title: Update CLAUDE.md to distinguish META_QUESTION signal from REPLAN_ESCALATE
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## What
Update CLAUDE.md to document META_QUESTION as a distinct signal from REPLAN_ESCALATE.

Currently CLAUDE.md (line ~104) mentions 'preplanning emits REPLAN_ESCALATE: brainstorm for unresolved gaps' but makes no mention of META_QUESTION. After this epic (specifically story 0ecc-65f3), the brainstorm Phase 1 Gate emits META_QUESTION when a question's blocking_for resolves to brainstorm itself — this MUST NOT be handled as REPLAN_ESCALATE (which would loop).

Update the existing mention of REPLAN_ESCALATE in the 'Epic scrutiny pipeline' sentence to note:
- REPLAN_ESCALATE: used when mid-workflow question discovery from phases later than brainstorm requires routing back to brainstorm
- META_QUESTION: emitted by brainstorm Phase 1 Gate when blocking_for resolves to brainstorm itself; escalates to user directly — does NOT REPLAN_ESCALATE

The distinction is: REPLAN_ESCALATE loops back through brainstorm orchestration; META_QUESTION surfaces directly to the user to prevent an infinite loop.

This should be a one-sentence clarification added to the existing Epic scrutiny pipeline note, keeping with CLAUDE.md BLOAT criteria (rule b in Architectural Invariants: no duplicate rules, no verbose inline content).

Satisfies: ec78-d60d done definition 3.
